newsitem.title: GERMANY: SWIMMING-VAN ALMSICK OUT FOR REST OF SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-VAN ALMSICK OUT FOR REST OF SEASON.

text.p: World champion Franziska Van Almsick will be out for the rest of the season following a motorcycle accident that has left her needing an operation on her hand, it was reported on Thursday.
"We can only help that she will be able to prepare properly for the world championships in January," an official at her swimming club in Berlin said.
Van Almsick was involved in a collision with a car as she rode her mother's motorcycle through a Berlin suburb last week.
